candidates.sql: SELECT T1."Name" FROM "country" AS T1 INNER JOIN "countrylanguage" AS T2 ON T1."Code" = T2."CountryCode" WHERE T2."Language" = 'English' INTERSECT SELECT TR1."Name" FROM "country" AS TR1 INNER JOIN "countrylanguage" AS TR2 ON TR1."Code" = TR2."CountryCode" WHERE TR2."Language" = 'French'

candidates.label: B
candidates.sql: SELECT T1."Name" FROM "country" AS T1 INNER JOIN "countrylanguage" AS T2 ON T1."Code" = T2."CountryCode" WHERE T2."Language" IN ('French', 'English') INTERSECT SELECT TR1."Name" FROM "country" AS TR1 INNER JOIN "countrylanguage" AS TR2 ON TR1."Code" = TR2."CountryCode" WHERE TR2."Language" = 'French'

candidates.label: C
candidates.sql: SELECT T1."Name" FROM "country" AS T1 INNER JOIN "countrylanguage" AS T2 ON T1."Code" = T2."CountryCode" WHERE T2."Language" IN ('French', 'English') INTERSECT SELECT TR1."Name" FROM "country" AS TR1 INNER JOIN "countrylanguage" AS TR2 ON TR1."Code" = TR2."CountryCode" WHERE TR2."Language" = 'English'

candidates.label: D
candidates.sql: SELECT T1."Name" FROM "country" AS T1 INNER JOIN "countrylanguage" AS T2 ON T1."Code" = T2."CountryCode" WHERE T2."Language" = 'French' AND T2."IsOfficial" = 'T' INTERSECT SELECT TR1."Name" FROM "country" AS TR1 INNER JOIN "countrylanguage" AS TR2 ON TR1."Code" = TR2."CountryCode" WHERE TR2."Language" = 'French'
